name: Chephirah
overview: Chephirah is identified in Scripture as a city of the Hivites, mentioned alongside other Hivite cities such as Gibeon, Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim. The city appears in the context of Israel's journey and settlement, as seen in Joshua 9:17 and Joshua 18:26, highlighting its geographic and tribal significance. Additionally, Chephirah is noted in the post-exilic records of Ezra 2:25 and Nehemiah 7:29, indicating its continued importance among the returning exiles. These references collectively underscore Chephirah’s role as a persistent Hivite city within the biblical narrative of Israel’s history and restoration.
